bottleneck.identified: Morning Briefing PDF generation pipeline — execution timeout risk
bottleneck.evidence: 8:30 AM Morning Briefing has 6 consecutive errors. Delivery fix is applied. But the underlying job timed out at exactly 600s (the previous limit). Timeout bumped to 660s — a 10% increase. The PDF pipeline (local server boot + browser navigation + PDF rendering + git push) is the slow step. If it takes 661s today, it's error #7.
bottleneck.urgency: Fires at 8:30 AM CT — 6.5 hours from now
bottleneck.recommendation: Either (A) extend timeout to 900s for more buffer, or (B) strip PDF generation from the morning briefing cron — generate the briefing text and email, then let the hourly cron handle PDF creation separately. Option B is the compounding fix.

compoundingImprovement.suggestion: Decouple PDF generation from the Morning Briefing cron. The briefing cron should: (1) write the HTML, (2) send the email, (3) output the text summary. A separate lightweight task handles server + browser + PDF rendering. This splits a slow 600s+ job into a 90s briefing and a 120s PDF job. Eliminates timeout risk permanently. Same pattern applies to Shed Ads.
compoundingImprovement.compoundingMechanism: Every morning briefing is guaranteed to complete. No more timeout-caused missed mornings. TJ's primary activation signal becomes reliable. Reliability compounds into trust.
compoundingImprovement.priority: HIGH — implement before or alongside 8:30 AM test run today
